title: Kiran's salary for April
body: M/s Sharma Traders prepares its payroll on a spreadsheet. For April (30 days) the rules are: Dearness Allowance 35% of Basic Pay Earned (BPE); House Rent Allowance 40% of BPE for supervisory staff and 30% for non-supervisory staff; Transport Allowance Rs. 1,000 for supervisory and Rs. 500 for non-supervisory staff; Provident Fund 12% of BPE. Kiran is a supervisory employee with a Basic Pay of Rs. 24,000. In April she took 2 days of leave without pay and had 1 day of unauthorised absence. Her TDS for the month is Rs. 1,500 and her loan instalment is Rs. 2,000.

title: Fixed asset schedule of Sunrise Ltd
body: Sunrise Ltd prepares the schedule of fixed assets forming part of its balance sheet on a spreadsheet. For Plant and Machinery for the year 2008-09 it shows: Gross Block as at Apr 1, 2008 Rs. 8,00,000; Additions during the year Rs. 2,00,000; Deductions (assets sold) Rs. 50,000. Depreciation as at Apr 1, 2008 Rs. 2,40,000; depreciation for the year, transferred from the depreciation computation spreadsheet, Rs. 95,000; depreciation on assets sold (deductions) Rs. 15,000.
